name: CTT - Correios De Portugal, S.A.
summary: CTT - Correios De Portugal, S.A., in conjunction with its associated entities, offers a broad spectrum of postal and financial solutions on a global scale. The enterprise organizes its activities into four primary divisions: Mail, Express & Parcels, Financial Services & Retail, and a banking sector. Historically, the company was recognized as Correio Publico. Founded in 1520, CTT - Correios De Portugal, S.A. maintains its central office in Lisbon, Portugal.
